item.title: Hamilton Woman Booked On Probation Violation Warrant
item.description: A Hamilton woman was booked into the Caldwell County Detention Center on a probation violation warrant. Her hearing is set for March 6th. Twenty-two-year-old Rianna F. Eckenrod is held with bond set at $20,000 cash only. Eckenrod was placed on five years of probation in November of 2024, on a property damage conviction.
